evidence.quotation: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current semantics; original IOC-093 release independently checked. Not claimed as original 2005 wording.

evidence.quotation: The effect of this card will not negate "Creature Swap", "Fissure", "Smashing Ground", "Dark Hole", "Raigeki", or similar Spell Cards that do not target.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Goat FAQ for Freed the Matchless General explicitly identifies Smashing Ground as non-targeting. Community archive, not current Konami primary ruling.

notes: No cost, no target. Own open Main, hand or own Set. Requires opposing face-up monster; highest effective DEF selected at resolution, controller chooses if tied. Single-link pass-only; no immunity/replacement/modifiers/general mixed Chain. Face-down monsters excluded. Import historical text status remains pending.
